member.name: T:ConDmsLockerCmd.LockerController
member.summary:
Low-level RS-485 locker controller. Protocol: 9600 baud 8N1, BCC = XOR of all payload bytes.
Commands: Unlock single : 8A [board] [lock] 11 [BCC] lock = 0x01–0x32 (1–50) Check single : 80 [board] [lock] 33 [BCC] lock = 0x01–0x32 (1–50) Read all : 80 [board] 00 33 [BCC] Unlock multi : 90 [board] [S1][S2][S3][S4][S5][S6][S7] [BCC]
Read All response format (from spec): 80 [board] [S1][S2][S3][S4][S5][S6][S7] 33 [BCC] → 11 bytes S1 = ch 1-8, S2 = ch 9-16, S3 = ch 17-24, S4 = ch 25-32, S5 = ch 33-40, S6 = ch 41-48, S7 = ch 49-50 (only bits 0-1 used)
NOTE on Read All status bits (no feedback wiring): When feedback lines (pins 6/7) are NOT connected, board returns 0xFF by default. bit=0 → Open (relay triggered), bit=1 → Closed (inverted)
